topology: Air-cooled room + modulating aggregate water chiller + indirect fully mixed chilled-water TES; no free cooling, ESS, PV, CHP, liquid CDU, or converter switching
assumptions: IT is provisionally treated as downstream-of-UPS server AC input including internal server fans/PSUs; NLR measurement boundary is not fully verified.
No post-generation IT/PCC scaling and no PUE multiplier. A 20 MW average is a design reference, not a DOE import cap.
All IT, auxiliary and configured UPS losses enter one equivalent air-room heat state. This is not a validated liquid-cooled AIDC topology.
Weather and all equipment sizes/efficiencies except COP=5 (PL13 case value) are transparent illustrative assumptions, not measured site data.
COP=5 is retained from PL13 Table 1 only as a comparison setting; it is not a selected vendor performance map.
Aggregate chiller modulation is algebraic within capacity; compressor start/stop, minimum part-load and actuator dynamics are not modeled.
TES heat ports are measured at tank boundary (no duplicate round-trip efficiency); heat exchanger effectiveness limits flow/temperature capability.
TES pump heat and chilled-water pump heat enter the plant water load; condenser pump heat is rejected at the tower.
Fully mixed tank temperature is a conservative/simple topology hypothesis, not a model of a verified stratified storage tank.
Dispatch clock is elapsed simulation time modulo 24, not local peak tariff or a demand forecast. Terminal recovery is a comparison boundary condition.
Temperature limits are illustrative scenario constraints, not a grid code/ASHRAE certification or a chip hot-spot temperature guarantee.
Only active-power PCC operation is modeled. Reactive power, voltage dependence, protection and FRT are deferred.
